source: University of Cambridge estate building energy archive (Langtry & Choudhary 2024, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10955332), CC BY 4.0
note: hour 0 is the forecast origin; negative hours are the 1,344-hour context. ankyra_kw is ankyra-lite (the column keeps the release's name), carrier_kw the small carrier network alone (three-seed forecast at the origin, before the anchoring layer), timesfm_kw zero-shot TimesFM 2.5
selection: the release's example window (UCam_Building_b37, origin 2011-09-01) lies before the Cambridge test set; this is the test window of the same building whose origin is nearest to it
